title: pm-dispatch: the claim template spells the ceiling tier by its constant name and cites the --tier MANDATORY path line, never the model id
body:
Fixes #21048
Clause-②: no

## What

The `Claim:` comment template's `Container & model:` line told every seat to quote this run's `--tier` output into the `model:` slot — and the headline `--tier` prints for a mandated surface is the model id. This repo's `AGENTS.md` (Multi-agent discipline, the 「Commit message」 paragraph) and objectui's `AGENTS.md` (which quotes it verbatim) carry the same rule: no model identifier lands in a comment. So every governed sister-repo claim obeyed one rule by breaking the other — the card's finding.

The recogniser half is already on `main` (commit `47849e72`, 2026-09-27): `ceilingTierSpellings()` lists the constant NAME `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` beside the value and the ladder word; `readContainerModelLine` / `containerModelRefusal` read a ceiling spelled by the NAME when the same line carries `MANDATORY` or `reason:`, refuse it bare, and quote no model id back; `post-stamped.mjs` runs that reader before writing a claim. This PR is the **template half only**: two protocol sentences rewritten in place, zero net lines, no code.

### Files (2 lines changed, +2 / −2)

| File | What changed | Lines | Bytes on the line |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉 | the claim template's `Container & model:` line, rewritten in place: the `model:` placeholder now says — tier word, quoting this run's `--tier` output; the ceiling is spelled `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and cites, on the same line, the MANDATORY path line `--tier` printed or a `reason:`; never copy the model id | 319 → 319 (ceiling 319) | 118 → 219 — a fenced line, structurally outside the 120-byte cap |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 〈认领〉 | the `--tier` sentence, rewritten in place: the tier cites `dispatch-gates --tier --repo REPO` (the sister-repo form included, the same idiom as the file's 门禁清单 sentence), never memory; the ceiling is spelled by its constant name with its citation on the same line; never copy the model id | 183 → 183 (ceiling 183) | 120 → 119 (cap 120) |

Not touched: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (frozen by ruling 208 R6; its half is done and pinned), the 〈升级与决策〉 frame block (`check:skill-frame-sync`), the card's assignee.

### Why one spelling for every repo

The triage left it to the claim whether objectstack itself keeps or adopts the model-free spelling. Both `AGENTS.md` files carry the identical comment rule, so there is no repo where the model-id spelling is legal in a claim comment; one spelling keeps the template one line and is exactly what the recogniser already reads. The PM's claim on this card (comment 5942779919) is written in the new shape and passed `post-stamped`'s claim reader before it was posted — a live measurement of the template, not a fixture.

## Verification (tree `30c530e5` = this branch's base; final head `aa492785`)

These are the triage's two pins (model-free spelling passes; no-tier-at-all is still refused) — already landed, none added here.
- Direct probe (`node --input-type=module -e` importing `readContainerModelLine` / `containerModelRefusal`): the PM's claim line on this card → `tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, ceiling: true, mandateCited: true, refused: false`; the same shape with a sister-repo `--tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui PATH` citation → ceiling, mandate cited, no refusal; `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with nothing behind it → refused, and the refusal text contains no id-form model name; a default-tier line → no refusal.

## Acceptance notes

- **Boundary, noted not filed.** The default and floor tiers are still spelled by the ladder words `--tier` prints; the recogniser has no model-free equivalent for them and this PR invents none (`dispatch-gates.mjs` is frozen; no new vocabulary). Every sister-repo card under `skills/**` is ceiling by clause ①, so the shape that produced the finding is covered; a default-tier sister-repo claim still carries a ladder word. Carrier: none.
- **No third protocol site.** `--tier` is also mentioned in `references/landing-operations.md` (line 9, the suspect-line rule), `references/platform-readings.md` (lines 393–396, quota and sister-tree readings) and `references/lanes/skills.md` (line 18, 「档位从 `--tier` 推导引用」) — none teaches quoting the output into the `model:` slot, so the file surface is the two files named. `post-stamped.mjs`'s `CLAIM_KEY_SPELLINGS` prescription already spells the new shape; `references/contract-review.md` already spells `Served-tier:` by the constant name.
- **The `--repo` spelling.** The old sentence hard-coded `--repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`; the new one reads `--repo 仓` (REPO), because the sister-repo route `--tier --repo owner/name PATH…` is the very case the card is about and the file already uses that idiom for `--commands`.
- **Changeset.** `.claude/**` publishes nothing → `skip-changeset` (via `label-write`).
- **Landing.** Tier S governed surface: this PR stays draft; the owning seat lands it on a `## Contract review` record (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, PASS). This dev does not flip ready, queue or arm auto-merge.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
两句协议文本原地改写:认领评论模板的 `Container & model:` 行(SKILL.md 〈模板与表〉),以及 execution-duties 〈认领〉里「引 `--tier` 输出」那句。天花板档现在写常量名 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`,同行引 `--tier` 打印的 MANDATORY 路径行或 `reason:`;⛔ 不再把 `--tier` 标题行里的模型 id 抄进评论。行数不变(319/319、183/183),不碰冻结的 `dispatch-gates.mjs`。

### 为什么改
两条活规则冲突:模板教席位引 `--tier` 输出(含模型 id),而本仓与 objectui 的 AGENTS.md 都禁止评论里出现模型标识,姊妹仓的每条认领都在违反其中一条。识别器半边(接受常量名、要求同行引据、拒收文案不回显 id、`post-stamped` 写前先读)已随早先的 PR 在 main 并有 self-test pin;本 PR 只补模板半边。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
纯协议文本,零代码、零发布面,20 个派生门禁本地跑过。已知边界:默认/下限档的档位词仍是 `--tier` 打印的梯度词,识别器无 model-free 等价词,本 PR 不造新词表;姊妹仓 `skills/**` 卡恒为天花板档,实际被覆盖。回滚 = revert 本 commit,无数据、无迁移。
